public.text: Deferring to external specifications creates a dependency on their lifecycle. Profiles may be revised, retired, replaced, or unsupported by current test tooling.
public.suggestedRevision: Establish a standards lifecycle policy covering profile selection, version pinning, updates, deprecation, replacement, compatibility, and continued availability of test artefacts.
